targets.outcome_quote: Based on two undergraduate samples (total N = 415) in Singapore, the cued distance manipulation (proximal vs. distal) successfully led to different spatial distance perceptions in both samples; however, we were unable to replicate the effect of cued distance manipulation on mental construal.
targets.outcome_reasoning: Authors explicitly report failure to replicate the cued-distance effect on mental construal; a successful distance manipulation does not override the failed substantive test. Citation appears in the abstract, with author initials additionally exposed in the publisher reference listing.
